title: com.progress arguments (fabric-project-comms/0.1, DEC-0073)
description: Extends the leases like com.renew and changes no state. Estate, caller Project, principal and session come from the authenticated endpoint and are never accepted here: an unknown field is refused (invalid_arguments).

note.description: A progress note, posted as the responder's message on the request's thread at most once per attempt and idempotency key; a repeat posts nothing.
